{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.18

|arg= global

|gr1= Object Detection

|descr= Sets a target to be ignored by this Group. It will not appear in [[nearTargets]] and the group will not notice its presence. [[targetKnowledge]] can be used to check if a target is currently ignored. While a unit is ignored, [[reveal]] has no effect.

|s1= group [[ignoreTarget]] target

|p1= group : [[Object]] or [[Group]] - which receives revealing information

|p2= target: [[Object]] - which would be ignored

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= group [[ignoreTarget]] [target, isIgnored]

|p21= group : [[Object]] or [[Group]] - which receives revealing information

|p22= target: [[Object]] - which would be ignored

|p23= isIgnored: [[Boolean]] - whether the target should be ignored

|r2= [[Nothing]]



|x1= <sqf>aiGroup ignoreTarget player</sqf>

|seealso= [[knowsAbout]] [[targetsQuery]] [[targetsAggregate]] [[nearTargets]] [[reveal]] [[targetKnowledge]]
}}
